items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We'll have to speak to Bourgois about that.

ctx.x: I don’t recall there being any white members of Benny’s band. That’s not to say that Benny’s band never included a white musician, but while I was there, there was never a white musician. That I can say with some accuracy. During the two or three year stint with Benny that I was there, it was not an integrated band. We'll have to speak to Bourgois about that. [The Bakers laugh]
Did you find that there were problems with discrimination in traveling with that band, just as there had been earlier with the other bands that you had been with?
